content.short: SanR.app is a decentralized signals platform where you can practice your crypto trading skills.
content.description: SanR.app is a decentralized platform that helps you sift through market chatter to identify meaningful signals amid the noise by applying your market research and analytical skills. It supports discerning shifts in the crypto market without being overwhelmed by clutter, enabling a clearer view of what matters. Veteran traders and data scientists rely on SanR.app to spot trends and actionable insights while filtering out excess and irrelevant information, across multiple chains.
